newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.AFRICAN MAY TRACTOR SALES FALL 26 PERCENT YR/YR.
newsitem.headline: S.AFRICAN MAY TRACTOR SALES FALL 26 PERCENT YR/YR.

text.p: South African tractor sales were 25.8 percent down on a year ago in May at 498 units and in the year to date sales were down 2.6 percent, the Agricultural Machinery Association said on Thursday.
The association said the disappointing sales followed late rains which delayed summer crop harvesting, adding farmers were uncertain about future price prospects.
